accessPolicy.note: DailyMed provides company-submitted current in-use SPL labeling and a versioned API. NLM does not review SPL content before publication, and DailyMed labeling may differ from the most recent FDA-approved or distributed label. NLM policy distinguishes government works from potentially protected company-contributed material and places item-level rights responsibility on the user.
